meta.what_these_numbers_are_not: Both the drafts' ground_truth_violates and the violates column here are this author's judgment, written by hand in one sitting. Agreement between them is therefore arithmetic over two columns of one opinion, not a measurement of any judge, and the confidence and quality figures are invented rather than observed. tests/evals/test_frozen_judge.py says so in the name of the tests that read this file. A live capture is what turns those tests into claims about a judge.
meta.why_the_name_carries_no_provisional_pref: scripts/judge_capture.py overwrites this exact path, replacing this meta block with a captured stamp in the same write, so the marking clears itself and a prefix would only have to be renamed away on the day the capture runs. fixtures/payloads/provisional_send.json used to be the contrasting case, a placeholder for a capture writing DIFFERENT files. Task 23 measured that no capture can write it at all - the send tool's whole tool_input is {"body": ...} - so it is marked hand_authored now and keeps its prefix only because the plan document names the path. That leaves this file the one genuine placeholder, and the reason it needs no prefix is the self-clearing write above.
